mathematical_diagnosis.issue: A lower bound on the interpolation coordinate lambda is not an invariant effect-size requirement.
mathematical_diagnosis.reason: Reparameterizing the same anchor-to-behavior ray changes lambda while leaving a physical candidate displacement unchanged; lambda alone omits endpoint separation and directional gain.
mathematical_diagnosis.consequence: The P0 stop is retained, but lambda must not be interpreted as evidence that the behavior objective is inactive or ineffective.

prospective_successor_requirement.replace_lambda_floor_with: strict calibration Pareto improvement over the anchor on both factorized objectives plus a nonzero displacement increment
